summary: A standalone Nippon Ichi tactical RPG revived on PC and Switch through Prinny Presents NIS Classics Volume 1.

entries.title: Soul Nomad & the World Eaters
entries.definitive_edition: Prinny Presents NIS Classics Volume 1 PC release

emulation.notes: Use PC for the main run.

primary.version: Prinny Presents NIS Classics Volume 1 PC release
primary.why: The modern PC release brings Soul Nomad back from PS2/PSN with the strongest capture and display-control route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Steam/PC release from Prinny Presents NIS Classics Volume 1; use the PS2 original only for comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: Modern rerelease rather than a ground-up remake.
